findings.title: Failed PARAM write is absent from the capture total API-attempt count
findings.trigger: In reservation mode, the PARAM_REQUEST_LIST writer throws or reports fewer than fourteen accepted bytes after Begin-R19ParamListWrite has latched its one attempt.
findings.cause: The live caller increments serialWrites only after Invoke-R19ParamListRequest returns true. Set-R19GrantReservationParamWriteResult throws PARAM_WRITE_INCOMPLETE_NO_RETRY before the helper returns, so the caller skips the increment even though the request API was invoked.
findings.effect: The saved request ledger contains request_attempts=1 while serial_write_calls omits that invocation. The outer exact-count gate rejects the saved evidence, preventing the subsequent diagnostic stage reads for this bounded failure. There is no request retry, unsafe release, or successful-path effect.

reproduction.method: Imported definitions only; constructed a real Bound workflow with actual codec/workflow helpers; invoked the real request helper with an in-memory throwing writer; used the live caller's try/if bookkeeping.

findings.suggested_fix: Account for the request attempt from a before/after write_attempts delta in a finally block, or increment through an attempt callback fixed immediately before writer invocation. Regress the actual caller bookkeeping for both partial and throwing writers.

fix_source_review.result: The actual live caller now captures write_attempts before the helper and adds the delta to serialWrites in finally. This directly covers helper throws and partial acceptance without incrementing for a gate rejection.
fix_source_review.test_status: Pending root/runner narrow regression; root full host suite was already running.

checked_relationships.evidence: TailReady is produced only from completion of the existing standard writer physical-tail service for the reserved tuple. limitations.classification: Explicit evaluation limitation, not a confirmed physical telemetry mismatch
limitations.detail: The v10 raw reader and outer replay independently bind/decode each local record but do not automatically join USB workflow observations and both JTAG records across boot/epoch/reader/nonce/Grant/token/generation or compute both500ms intervals. Decoder and workflow protocol/high-speed/RF/acceptance outputs remain false. Root confirmed that the cross-role join and same-MCU intervals will be independently inspected from saved raw/event evidence; acquisition success must not be reported as protocol or product success.

Static sequencing and offline controller tests cannot prove that USB and RF latency fit the500ms windows, or that the diagnostic-only dual-USB hold succeeds on the powered hardware. Both XIAOs were off and no hardware operation was performed by this reviewer.
